title: Can cows prevent wildfires?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How can grazing animals reduce the amount of vegetation available to fuel wildfires?
Could using cattle or goats for fire prevention create environmental problems of its own?
Who should pay farmers if their animals are used as part of wildfire management?
Would this approach work everywhere, or only in certain landscapes?
What other low-tech solutions might be useful against increasingly severe wildfires?
